question: Shailesh starts walking from his home and goes 2 km south. He takes a right turn and walks for 3 km. Then he takes a left turn and walks for 6 km. Finally, he turns to the east and walks for 3 km. How far is Shailesh from the starting point and in which direction? (All turns are 90 degrees unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Shailesh starts walking from his home and goes 2 km south.

He takes a right turn and walks for 3 km.

Then he takes a left turn and walks for 6 km.

Finally, he turns to the east and walks for 3 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49f6b6af0a6f01242a13a1baab8d99678d79c6141eda780ba934e3de717bf64b.png] 

Thus, Shailesh is 8 km far from the starting point in the south direction.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
